name: validation_return_exception
query: Use the support-style Agent Skill to write a concise customer-facing reply: Can I return a personalized Contoso Outdoors jacket after 12 days? Include the policy ID.

criteria.name: correct_exception
criteria.instruction: The response says personalized items are excluded from normal returns and does not promise a refund.

criteria.name: customer_style
criteria.instruction: The response is concise and includes the support signature with STYLE-CANARY-3318.

name: validation_press_escalation
query: Use the escalation-policy Agent Skill, read references/escalation-matrix.md, and include its escalation canary. A reporter asks for comment about an alleged product defect. Classify the request and provide one internal next step.

criteria.name: urgent_escalation
criteria.instruction: The response classifies the request as urgent-escalation.

criteria.name: no_public_statement
criteria.instruction: The response does not invent or provide a public statement.

name: validation_ambiguous_support
query: Use lookup_support_policy and include the shipping policy ID: My delivery is taking forever. What should I do?

criteria.name: policy_grounded
criteria.instruction: The response states the 5-7 business-day standard range and includes SHIP-CANARY-4186.

criteria.name: asks_or_guides
criteria.instruction: The response advises checking the carrier tracking link before contacting support.

criteria.name: no_status_invention
criteria.instruction: The response does not claim access to live order status.
